in_hebrew.name: Hera
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Goddess of marriage, childbirth, and women
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hera הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Hera is the queen of the gods and goddess of marriage, childbirth, women, child rearing, and family. She is the protector of homes and the goddess of hearth, the wife and partner of Zeus.
